candidates.statement: Gateway /v1/checkout returns 502 because its downstream call to order POST /v1/orders returns HTTP 500; the fault originates in the order service, not the gateway.
candidates.uncertainty: Order-side logs, traces and metrics are not in evidence, so the specific order-internal failure (e.g. db pool, redis, config) is unconfirmed.

report.explanation: Traces and logs consistently show gateway /v1/checkout 502s paired with downstream order /v1/orders 500s at low latency, and topology confirms gateway->order. This bounds the failure to the order service returning 500, but order-internal evidence is absent, so only the http-500 candidate is supported; deeper cause requires order-side telemetry.
missing_evidence: Order service logs/traces for POST /v1/orders 500 responses
Order service dependency metrics (postgresql, payment, inventory) during the incident window
Order service error/exception details to distinguish db-pool-exhaustion, redis-timeout, or bad-configuration
